STEP 2 - Vessel: square white plate ~26 cm side; treat as dinner plate, diameter ~26 cm.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: ~380 g and ~570 kcal is plausible for a plate about two-thirds covered with eggs, bacon, grain and berries.
